scope: Specified tower descent and explicit block algorithms only; child generation and target setup remain charged; no formal kernel or signed standing
statement: For a split squarefree degree-N Dickson fibre, exact subtree-emptiness decisions yield 1+2 sum_j |D_(2^j)(Z)| node tests, bounded by O(1+z(1+log(N/z))) with one test when z=0. Scalar norm transforms retain degree 2N or 2N-1. Standard recursive norm evaluation requires N leaves on empty-root queries; dimension-charged terminal empty blocks cost Omega(N-z). These scoped written arguments identify a missing sublinear emptiness oracle, not an impossibility theorem or a new faster solver.
